Context: gemengde dataformaten, ontbreke: Context: mixed data formats, missing transaction references and manual processing cause delays, errors and higher personnel costs.

Stap 1 — Diagnose (eigenaar: ondernemer: Step 1 — Diagnosis (owner: business owner / finance lead)
- Verzamel huidige flows: welke betaalme: - Gather current flows: which payment methods, which payment providers, and how are transaction extracts received (CSV, email, bank feed)?
- Meet nulmeting: frequentie van handmat: - Take a baseline measurement: frequency of manual corrections and average time per month spent on reconciliation.

- Beslissing: automatiseren via directe: - Decision: automate via direct API connection or via middleware/integrator.
- Criteria: data-integriteit (transactie: - Criteria: data integrity (transaction reference and customer ID present), frequency (real-time vs daily), compliance requirements (VAT, storage of supporting documents) and budget.
- Meetpunt: keuze vastleggen in 1 week n: - Metric: record the choice within 1 week after diagnosis.
Stap 3 — Technische voorbereiding (eigen: Step 3 — Technical preparation (owner: IT lead / external developer)
- Eis 1: transacties moeten een consiste: - Requirement 1: transactions must have a consistent reference (order number, invoice number or customer ID).
- Eis 2: beschikbaarheid van webhooks of: - Requirement 2: availability of webhooks or batch extracts with at minimum the fields: date, amount, currency, transaction reference, payment method, fees.
- Eis 3: mappingplan vanuit betaalprovid: - Requirement 3: mapping plan from payment provider data to accounting fields (general ledger, VAT codes, offset account).
- Tijd: maak dit mappingplan binnen 10 w: - Time: create this mapping plan within 10 working days.
Stap 4 — Proof of Concept (PoC) (eigenaa: Step 4 — Proof of Concept (PoC) (owner: IT + accountant)
- Bouw een korte PoC die 1 betaalmethode: - Build a short PoC that automates 1 payment method and runs for 2 weeks in a test environment.
- Go/no-go criteria: >95% automatische m: - Go/no-go criteria: >95% automatic matching of transactions during the test period or an acceptable improvement plan.
Stap 5 — Implementatie en processen (eig: Step 5 — Implementation and processes (owner: operations / accounting)
- Rolverdeling: wie controleert mismatch: - Role distribution: who checks mismatches, who handles chargebacks and who reports KPIs.
- Proces: dagstart dashboard voor open i: - Process: start-of-day dashboard for open items, weekly reconciliation between finance and sales.
- Doeluitkomst: transacties binnen T+1 w: - Target outcome: transactions matched within T+1 workday or placed in an exception queue with an owner.
Stap 6 — Beveiliging en compliance (eige: Step 6 — Security and compliance (owner: compliance / security)
- Controleer opslag van betalingsbewijze: - Check storage of payment receipts, encryption of API-keys and access levels for staff.
- Meetpunt: jaarlijkse auditcheck of con: - Measurement point: annual audit check or concrete 3-monthly risk review.

- Sluit de lus: signaal → context → gevo: - Close the loop: signal → context → consequence → decision → action → result → learning.
- Voorbeeld van lus: signaal = foutmeldi: - Example of a loop: signal = mismatch error messages; context = incomplete references; consequence = manual processing; decision = make order number mandatory at checkout; action = adjust checkout; result = reduction in mismatches; learning = update mapping & SLA.
Strategische keuze: real-time boekhoudin: Strategic choice: real-time accounting versus daily batch; choose based on cashflow sensitivity and costs.
Budgetposten: ontwikkeling (PoC), integr: Budget items: development (PoC), integration licenses or middleware, and 1-2 months extra support after go-live.
Mensen en rollen: ondernemer/CEO (beslui: People and roles: entrepreneur/CEO (decision), finance lead (owner of reconciliation), IT/partner (implementation), accountant (control & compliance), security/compliance (risk management).
Risico's en mitigaties: incomplete data: Risks and mitigations: incomplete data → require reference at checkout; API outage → fallback to batch export; incorrect VAT allocation → validation rules in mapping.
